column3: The Hebrew describes the divisions coming and going month by month; BSB interprets this as rotating military duty.
The Hebrew repeats his division before mentioning Mikloth; BSB omits that first repetition.
The Hebrew associates Heldai with Othniel without an explicit family noun; BSB supplies from the family of Othniel.
The Hebrew says the number did not go up into the account of the days of King David; BSB expresses this as not being entered in the Book of the Chronicles.
The Hebrew names towers as storehouse locations; BSB uses fortresses.
The Hebrew refers to storehouses of wine; BSB uses wine vats.
The Hebrew specifies female donkeys; BSB simply says donkeys.
